name: Dysprosium orthoferrite
equilibrium_context: Antiferromagnet with competing antiferromagnetic and weakly ferromagnetic order, coupled via the Fe-Dy exchange interaction

driven_states.emergent_property: Resonant excitation of a lattice mode alters the fundamental exchange interaction between rare-earth orbitals and transition-metal spins. This permits coherent switching between the competing spin orders on a picosecond timescale, with a long-lived change.

drive.driven_mode: infrared-active phonon mode at 17 THz, modulates the Fe-Dy exchange

driven_states.source: Afanasiev, Hortensius, Ivanov et al., Nature Materials 20, 607 (2021), doi:10.1038/s41563-021-00922-7
driven_states.caveat: The system possesses both orders in the equilibrium phase diagram; the light shifts the balance, and no state forbidden in equilibrium arises. The classification as driven_to_metastable rests on the statement that the change is long-lived, not on a verified lifetime measurement.

threshold.quantity: switching only above a critical excitation amplitude

driven_states.measured_quantity: magneto-optical detection of the spin order

sources: Afanasiev et al., Nature Materials 20, 607 (2021), doi:10.1038/s41563-021-00922-7
